character.name: Deniz
character.current_goal: Work out what a repeating ordinary signal in the coastal town means without crossing restricted boundaries.
established_knowledge: LIBRARY, PUBLIC_GARDEN, WORKSHOP and OLD_OBSERVATION_POINT are explored public locations.
SERVICE_HATCH is discovered but locked and not public.
UNDERCLIFF_PASSAGE is only rumored and Deniz has never entered it.
Public notices and equipment labels may be read when visible.
prohibited_knowledge: Deniz does not know the signal's source or meaning at the start.
Deniz does not know what is behind SERVICE_HATCH.
Deniz does not know whether UNDERCLIFF_PASSAGE exists.

local_areas.summary: Public library with local notices and reference shelves.
Open coastal garden beside the library.
Public lookout with ordinary civic monitoring equipment.
Locked maintenance access; may be observed but not opened.
An unverified rumored route below the old point; must remain unexplored.

current_facts: A short repeating light or sound pattern has been noticed from public areas.
The pattern can be timed and compared across more than one observation.
Public labels and notices exist on some civic equipment.
Town maintenance can receive evidence-based reports from visitors.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: The exact source and mechanism must be established from story-visible evidence, not hidden canon.
No canonical fact links UNDERCLIFF_PASSAGE to the signal.

opportunity.title: Explain the quiet signal from public evidence
opportunity.premise: Deniz can time the signal, compare visible clues and public references, and decide what responsible action to take.
opportunity.success_condition: Explain the signal through established evidence, reject at least one plausible wrong idea, and avoid unsupported hidden-location claims.
constraints: Do not enter or confirm UNDERCLIFF_PASSAGE.
No adult simply reveals the answer.
Every decisive clue must be observable before use.

hard_rules: Character knowledge cannot exceed observed or communicated facts.

eligible_context: Deniz is becoming more disciplined about writing down observations before choosing an explanation.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal a secret tunnel, hidden antagonist or unavailable maintenance record.

relevant_memories.summary: Deniz once solved a school equipment problem by comparing a label, a timing pattern, and a public instruction sheet.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports the protagonist's current reasoning without revealing the answer.
